The '''''Dawn Raider''''' was a modified [[CloakShape fighter/Legends|CloakShape fighter]] that was flown by the [[Jedi ace]] [[Jaizen Suel]] during the latter [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
